onboarding_welcome_subtitle: Birkly is installed and running. A few quick steps to finish setup.
onboarding_choose_starter_subtitle: Optional sample collections and a demo website. Blank always works. Marsk installs a demo journal site.
onboarding_starter_marsk_offline_note: Marsk needs an internet connection from this computer so Birkly can download the demo pack. You can continue with Blank.
onboarding_install_local_restart: To start again later, run ./start-server.sh from your Birkly folder, then open the admin URL above.
onboarding_install_cloud_lead: Birkly is on your web server.
onboarding_install_cloud_writable: Ensure content/, media/, users/, and settings/ stay writable.
onboarding_install_default_start_here: Re-open 0_START-HERE.html from your Birkly folder if you need local vs cloud setup notes.
onboarding_install_next_help: On the next step, name your project and optionally pick a starter template.
onboarding_generic_error: An error occurred. Please try again.
onboarding_skip_confirm: Skip setup? You can finish later from the dashboard.
